diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted late readings flatten around 1.08-1.10 after ~9 h, consistent with reader saturation rather than a true biomass plateau. Diluting retained late aliquots brings the signal back into a proportional range: 18 h at 10x gave 0.5245/0.5157/0.5340 (mean 0.5247), i.e. ~5.25 OD-equivalent, versus the undiluted 1.1027. A 20x 18 h read of 0.2514 gives ~5.03 OD-equivalent, agreeing with the 10x estimate and supporting linearity of the diluted assay. Final-hours 10x reads at 16 h and 17 h likewise imply ~5.16 and ~5.22 OD-equivalent, ~4.8x the undiluted readings. Thus late-culture biomass is substantially higher than the undiluted plate-reader values indicate.
